subject.why: The beanstalk is immediately recognisable with its twisting vine, leaves, and golden bean pods.

category.why: Category 4 requires visible sky above the object, but the top of the beanstalk extends completely out of the frame; additionally, clouds surround the beanstalk on all sides rather than staying near the horizon.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, logos, or characters present.

framing.why: The beanstalk is cut off at the top edge of the image rather than maintaining a clear margin and sky above it.

colour.why: The palette is vibrant, saturated, and the green plant and golden beans stand out well against the blue sky.

detail.why: Clean, smooth surfaces without micro-textures, grooves, or distracting clutter.

style.why: Renders with chunky volumes, a soft satin sheen, and no outlines, matching the reference cards.

fix: Scale down the beanstalk and lower its top tip so that it stays fully within the frame with clear sky above it, and keep the clouds concentrated near the horizon.
